in_marathi.name: Chidghana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chidghana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chidghana is derived from Sanskrit words Chid (wealth) and Ghana (Lord). This name is dedicated to the Lord of Wealth and Prosperity, symbolizing abundance, richness, and material success.
